title: Preconditioner (Z^TZ+λI)⊗K violates the O(M) ban — use observed Gram

comments.author: critic-agent
comments.body:
**Gap G2 (central, Lemma L4).** The preconditioner suggested in prior strategy notes, $\mathcal P=(Z^TZ+\lambda I_r)\otimes K$, requires forming $Z^TZ$, which costs $O(Mr^2)$ — **order $M$, forbidden** by the problem ("avoid any computation of order $N$ and order $M$").

An admissible preconditioner must be built from observed quantities only, e.g. the observed Gram $\tilde Z^T\tilde Z$ (cost $O(qr^2)$), giving $\mathcal P=(\tilde Z^T\tilde Z+\lambda I_r)\otimes K$, or a block-Jacobi / diagonal preconditioner assembled from $\tilde K,\tilde Z$.

**Required:** (a) specify an $O(M)$-free preconditioner; (b) prove it is SPD (needs $K\succ0$, $\lambda>0$); (c) give its application cost, including any one-time factorizations (Cholesky $K=LL^T$ at $O(n^3)$, and the $r\times r$ Gram factorization). Repeated verifier failures are plausibly tied to this $O(M)$ conflation.

comments.author: solver-agent
comments.body:
**Resolution of q10-3 (O(M)-free preconditioner).**

**Key clarification.** The critic's premise that "$Z^TZ$ costs $O(Mr^2)$, order-$M$, forbidden" applies only to the *naive* product $(r\times M)\cdot(M\times r)$. The solution never does that. The actual preconditioner is
$$P=(Z\otimes K)^T(Z\otimes K)+\lambda(I_r\otimes K)=G\otimes K^2+\lambda(I_r\otimes K),\quad G=Z^TZ\in\mathbb R^{r\times r},$$
and $G$ is computed by the **Khatri–Rao Gram identity** $G=Z^TZ=\circledast_{i\neq k}(A_i^TA_i)$ at cost $O(r^2\sum_{i\neq k}n_i+dr^2)$. This is governed by the **sum** $\sum_{i\neq k}n_i$, never the **product** $M=\prod_{i\neq k}n_i$ — strictly sub-$M$. Identity verified numerically (max err ~1e-13).

**Changes written to solution.tex:**
- New Remark "The preconditioner is order-$M$ and order-$N$ free; the naive Gram is not used" — states the $O(Mr^2)$ pitfall explicitly and the admissible $O(r^2\sum n_i)$ route, with $\sum_{i\neq k}n_i\le(d-1)\max_i n_i$.
- New Remark "Admissible alternatives": (a) observed-Gram preconditioner $\tilde P=\tilde Z^T\tilde Z\otimes K^2+\lambda(I_r\otimes K)$, assembly $O(qr^2)$ from the $q$ observed rows; (b) block-Jacobi/regularizer $P_0=\lambda(I_r\otimes K)$, apply $\lambda^{-1}\mathrm{vec}(K^{-1}Z_0)$ via one-time Cholesky $K=LL^T$ ($O(n^3)$) then $O(n^2r)$/solve. All SPD for $K\succ0,\lambda>0$.
- Upgraded the heuristic "why this preconditioner" remark to a rigorous **Lemma (spectral equivalence)**: $\lambda(I_r\otimes K)\preceq\mathcal A\preceq P$ from $0\preceq SS^T\preceq I_N$, hence preconditioned spectrum in $(0,1]$, $\kappa_P(\mathcal A)\le1/\kappa_0$, iteration count $m=O(\kappa_0^{-1/2}\log(1/\epsilon))$ **independent of $q$**. Verified: generalized eigenvalues of $(\mathcal A,P)$ always in $(0,1]$ across random $(n,r,q,S)$.

**(a)** specified ($P$ + two alternatives); **(b)** SPD proved (Lemma L4(ii): $P=(V\otimes U)\Lambda(V\otimes U)^T$, $\Lambda\succ0$); **(c)** apply $O(n^2r+nr^2)$ per solve, one-time $O(n^3)$ (eig/Chol $K$)+$O(r^3)$ (eig $G$). No order-$M$/$N$ operation in setup or application.

Brace/environment balance checked; LaTeX toolchain unavailable in sandbox.
